lines.speaker: sora
lines.text: Hey Captain, whatcha doing?

lines.speaker: sora
lines.text: Thinking about me? ♥
Yes, I'm thinking about you, Sora.
No, I'm cleaning my room.

lines.speaker: sora
lines.text: Hehe! That makes me so happy! ♥

lines.speaker: sora
lines.text: What else were you doing besides that?
Cleaning my room.

lines.speaker: sora
lines.text: All by yourself?

lines.speaker: sora
lines.text: I figured other Nikkes would be helping you. ★
They do sometimes, but I usually do it on my own.

lines.speaker: sora
lines.text: Wow.

lines.speaker: sora
lines.text: Very impressive. ♥

lines.speaker: sora
lines.text: Could you share some tips with me?

lines.speaker: sora
lines.text: Cielo and Sky are always saying

lines.speaker: sora
lines.text: how bad I am at organizing,

lines.speaker: sora
lines.text: but I don't get it. ★

lines.speaker: sora
lines.text: Although it's true that once I buy something, I never want to throw it away!

lines.speaker: sora
lines.text: It's such a waste to get rid of something that you spent so much time and effort purchasing. ♥

lines.speaker: sora
lines.text: So, I usually tuck them away somewhere, or put them into a pile. ★

lines.speaker: sora
lines.text: Every time Sky and Cielo come over,

lines.speaker: sora
lines.text: they nag at me.

lines.speaker: sora
lines.text: They say I should throw away this junk, as they call it, and tidy up. ★

lines.speaker: sora
lines.text: But if you ask me, none of it's junk!

lines.speaker: sora
lines.text: It feels to me like everything is perfectly well organized, too. ★

lines.speaker: sora
lines.text: When I want something,

lines.speaker: sora
lines.text: I know where to find it.

lines.speaker: sora
lines.text: Isn't that the definition of organization?

lines.speaker: sora
lines.text: How do you organize things, Captain?
I use the same approach. As long as I know where it is, and I can reach it, it's good enough for me.

lines.speaker: sora
lines.text: Oh man. ★

lines.speaker: sora
lines.text: I should save this

lines.speaker: sora
lines.text: and show it to Sky and Cielo later! ♥
Still, it might not be a bad idea to throw out a few things that you don't use.

lines.speaker: sora
lines.text: Oh! ★

lines.speaker: sora
lines.text: But what if I end up needing it later?

lines.speaker: sora
lines.text: That actually happened before!

lines.speaker: sora
lines.text: Sky threw out an empty delivery box

lines.speaker: sora
lines.text: that she had deemed useless,

lines.speaker: sora
lines.text: but the very next day,

lines.speaker: sora
lines.text: something that had been listed forever as secondhand was finally sold!

lines.speaker: sora
lines.text: At that moment, we could have really used that box.

lines.speaker: sora
lines.text: After that, I've been extra careful not to throw things out. ★
... I see.

lines.speaker: sora
lines.text: Hahaha, Captain, you should be careful not to throw things out carelessly as well.

lines.speaker: sora
lines.text: Oh right, weren't you cleaning your room?

lines.speaker: sora
lines.text: I hope I didn't distract you. ♥

lines.speaker: sora
lines.text: Go ahead and finish up so you can rest. ★

lines.speaker: sora
lines.text: I'll be in touch. ♥
Looks like I've failed to convince Sora to throw some things out.
